We ordered the spring rolls three ways, duck with lotus root, pineapple fried rice, fried chicken noodles, a chicken broth, and three drinks.

The flavours exploded on the palate and provided a wonderful introduction to Vietnamese cuisine. The broth served with the duck was especially delightful. Unfortunately, our eyes were bigger than our bellies, and we couldn’t quite finish everything. We felt awful leaving food behind because it was all so delicious.

The staff were incredibly attentive, checking that everything was alright when they noticed we had left some food. We were quick to reassure them that the meal had been excellent and that we had simply over-ordered.

At 755,000 VND (£21.37), we thought the meal was extremely reasonably priced for the quality of food and service we received.

Thank you to the team for such a wonderful welcome to Vietnam.
